verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents low-effort ways to accept online payments: no-code Payment Links, a pre-built Hosted Payment Page, and a minimal end-to-end quickstart. Instant self-serve signup is documented, but only for the sandbox, which uses no real money. Nothing shows how long production account approval takes before a founder can take a live card payment, so the 'within a day of signing up' part is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented production onboarding/KYC approval timeline, evidence of same-day live activation, independent or hands-on reports of time-to-first-live-payment.
